name: PlantEquipmentHireTracker
tagline: Know what is on hire, what it costs and what should go back – on every site.
description: Complete construction plant hire module in one Power Apps code component: on/off hire with status rules, chargeable-day costing (working or calendar days, minimum hire, breakdown credits, damage waiver), weekly burn, off-hire reminders and overdue flags, utilisation and idle plant, invoice reconciliation and cost to date by cost code, supplier and site.
features: Overdue off-hire flags with accrued cost
Chargeable days on working or calendar basis
Invoice tolerance checks and reconciliation notes
Cost to date, projected cost and weekly burn by cost code / supplier / site
Drag-and-drop hire board with business rules
